MFA: Multi-factor authentication: signing in with a password plus a second factor such as an authenticator app.
HRPortal: The HR self-service system used to request leave and view leave balances.
ExpenseHub: The expense-claim system where receipts are uploaded and claims are approved.
VPN: Virtual private network: the encrypted connection used to reach internal systems remotely.
BitLocker: Windows full-disk encryption used on all company laptops.
Company Portal: The catalogue of approved software that staff can install themselves.
